source: 上外版必修三 Unit 2 同主题完形(学书法/拜访工作室/一首歌的故事/画肖像/美术课/年轻雕塑家)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: My First Calligraphy Lesson
passages.text: On Saturday morning I went to my first Chinese calligraphy lesson. At first the brush felt strange in my hand, and my lines were thin and (1)____. My teacher, an old man with kind eyes, told me not to (2)____ up so easily. He said that every great artist had to (3)____ for years before the brush would obey him. He showed me how to hold the brush and how to control each (4)____ on the soft paper. "Do not try to fill the whole page," he said. "A little (5)____ space can make the work more beautiful." I watched him paint a single bamboo leaf in a fresh and lively (6)____. It looked so simple, yet it was full of (7)____. When I tried again, my hand was steadier, and I began to (8)____ how hard this art really was. By the end of the lesson I was tired but (9)____, because I had learned something new and old at the same time. I decided (10)____ back every week.

questions.explanation: 线条又细又「弱」(weak),与 thin 并列。
give up 放弃,固定短语。
练习 practise 多年才能掌握。
控制纸上的每一「笔触」(stroke)。
blank space 留白。
in a ... manner 以……方式;呼应课文 fresh and lively manner。
充满「情感」(feeling)。
appreciate 领会、体会这门艺术之难。
学到新东西,因而「高兴」(happy)。
decide to do,不定式作宾语(呼应本单元语法)。

passages.title: A Visit to the Painter's Studio
passages.text: Our art club was lucky enough to visit a famous painter's (1)____ last week. The room was filled with brushes, bottles of ink and half-finished pictures. The painter welcomed us with a warm (2)____ and asked us to sit down. He was (3)____ even in his seventies, and his eyes were still bright. He told us that he wanted (4)____ his love of nature through simple shapes. While we watched, he picked up a brush and, with a few (5)____ strokes, turned a blank sheet into a lively fish. We could hardly (6)____ how quickly it had happened. He explained that a good painter must (7)____ the brush with great care, because a single line cannot be changed. One student asked what (8)____ he hoped to send through his art. "Peace and joy," he answered with a gentle smile. Before we left, he encouraged each of us (9)____ our own style instead of copying others. We thanked him and walked home, (10)____ for such a wonderful afternoon.

questions.explanation: 画家的「工作室」(studio)。
热情的「问候」(greeting)。
七十多岁仍「精力充沛」(energetic)。
want to do,不定式作宾语。
充满活力的「笔触」(energetic strokes)。
几乎不敢「相信」(believe)。
必须小心「控制」(control)画笔。
想通过艺术传达什么「信息」(message)。
encourage sb to do,补足语带 to。
为美好的下午而「感激」(grateful)。

passages.title: The Story Behind a Song
passages.text: When the famous singer was young, he never (1)____ that one day he would win a great prize. As a teenager he only hoped his songs might be (2)____ in small coffee houses. He wrote about peace, freedom and the lives of (3)____ people. His music slowly reached a much bigger (4)____, and he made dozens of records. Years later, he was (5)____ a famous prize for literature, which surprised the whole world. He said he was deeply (6)____ that his songs had found a place in so many hearts. In his speech he (7)____ his warmest greetings to all the guests. He also remembered the great writers whose works were spoken of in (8)____ tones at school. Like them, he said, he was often (9)____ with both his art and ordinary daily matters. "Some things never change," he added, "even after four hundred years." The (10)____ rose to their feet and cheered for a long time.

questions.explanation: 从未「想象」(imagined)会获奖。
希望歌曲能被「听到」(heard)。
「普通」(ordinary)人的生活。
触及更大的「听众」(audience)。
be awarded a prize 被授予奖项。
深深「感激」(grateful)。
extend greetings 致以问候。
以「充满敬意」(respectful)的语气谈论。
be occupied with 忙于(固定搭配)。
「观众」(audience)起立欢呼。

passages.title: Painting My Grandmother
passages.text: For the school art show, I decided to paint a (1)____ of my grandmother. I wanted the picture to (2)____ how kind and patient she is. First I asked her to sit quietly by the window so that I could see every (3)____ of her face. The soft afternoon light made her grey hair (4)____ almost silver. I worked slowly, adding line after line, because I knew a single wrong (5)____ could ruin the whole picture. It was not easy, and at times I almost wanted to (6)____ up. But I kept telling myself to focus on the small (7)____, just as the great masters did. After three afternoons, the (8)____ was finally finished. When my grandmother saw it, her eyes filled with tears, and she was so (9)____ that she hugged me at once. The teacher later chose my work to be put (10)____ display in the school hall. I felt proud that art had helped me show my love.

questions.explanation: 画一幅「肖像」(portrait)。
想让画「展现」(show)祖母的善良。
看清脸上每一「细节」(detail)。
让头发「看起来」(look)像银色,系动词。
一处错误的「笔触」(stroke)。
give up 放弃。
专注于小「细节」(details)。
「画作」(painting)终于完成。
祖母如此「感激」(grateful)以至于拥抱我。
on display 陈列、展出(固定短语)。

passages.title: An Afternoon Art Class
passages.text: Our new art teacher, Miss Lin, has changed the way I see the world. On the first day she did not let us (1)____ at once. Instead, she made us close our eyes and (2)____ a happy moment. "Art begins with feeling," she said. Then she asked each of us to (3)____ that feeling on paper using only three colours. At first I had no idea what (4)____ paint, so I just made a few simple shapes. Miss Lin walked over, looked at my work, and (5)____ me to add more energetic lines. Slowly my page began to come (6)____. She told us that the easiest way to enjoy art is to (7)____ a work in its own time and place. She also said there is often no clear right or (8)____ answer in art. By the end of the class, the walls were (9)____ with bright pictures, and everyone wanted (10)____ them to friends. I had never enjoyed a lesson so much.

questions.explanation: 不让我们马上「画画」(paint)。
闭眼「想象」(imagine)一个快乐时刻。
用颜色「传达」(convey)那种感觉。
what to paint 疑问词+to do(呼应本单元语法)。
encourage sb to do,鼓励我加更多线条。
画面渐渐「活」(come alive)起来。
place a work in its time and place,把作品放在它的时空中。
right or wrong 对或错,固定搭配。
墙上「挂满」(be covered with)明亮的画。
want to do,不定式作宾语。

passages.title: The Young Sculptor
passages.text: Lin Tao was only sixteen, but everyone in town already (1)____ him as a gifted young artist. While other children played outside, he spent hours shaping wet clay with his hands. His dream was (2)____ a beautiful statue for the city park. The work was slow and difficult, and a single mistake could (3)____ days of effort. Yet Lin Tao refused (4)____ up. He studied the faces of ordinary people, trying to catch every (5)____ in their expressions. "A good statue should (6)____ real feeling," he often said. One evening a famous artist visited his small workshop and was (7)____ by what he saw. The man encouraged Lin Tao (8)____ his work to a national art show. To everyone's joy, the young sculptor won first prize, and his statue was put on (9)____ in the city museum. Standing beside his work, Lin Tao felt deeply (10)____ for all the help he had received along the way.

questions.explanation: 大家「认可」(recognised)他是有天赋的艺术家。
His dream was to do,不定式作表语。
一个错误会「浪费」(waste)多日努力。
refuse to do,不定式作宾语。
捕捉表情中的每个「细节」(detail)。
好的雕像应「传达」(convey)真实情感。
被所见「惊叹」(amazed)。
encourage sb to do,补足语带 to。
on display 陈列、展出(固定短语)。
对一路的帮助深深「感激」(grateful)。
